target.title: fix(browser): invalidate stale roleRefs on main-frame navigation
target.body:
Closes: N/A (source-first bug fix)

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where browser role refs (`e1`, `e2`, …) from a snapshot taken on page A could resolve to wrong elements on page B after a main-frame navigation. After clicking a link or submitting a form that navigates to a new URL, `PageState.roleRefs` remained populated with the previous page's accessibility refs. A subsequent `browser_click ref="e1"` would use `getByRole` or `aria-ref` against the new page, potentially clicking a completely different element.

Additionally, the `roleRefsByTarget` cache (designed to survive replacement `Page` objects) lacked navigation-lifecycle awareness — a replacement Page starting at generation zero could restore stale pre-navigation refs or reject fresh post-navigation refs.

## Why This Change Was Made

1. **framenavigated listener:** Added to `ensurePageState` — clears `roleRefs` / `roleRefsMode` / `roleRefsFrameSelector` when the main frame navigates (subframe navigations are preserved).

2. **Target-scoped navigation generation:** Navigation versioning lives at the `(cdpUrl, targetId)` cache boundary (`navGenerationByTarget`), not per-`PageState`. A `pageTargetKeys` WeakMap tracks which target each Page belongs to so `framenavigated` listeners bump the correct target-scoped generation. This ensures replacement Page objects for the same CDP target share the same document lifecycle.

3. **restore guard:** `restoreRoleRefsForTarget` compares the cached `navGen` with the current target generation. Stale pre-navigation entries are rejected; fresh post-navigation entries are correctly restored for replacement Pages.

## User Impact

- Stale refs after navigation now throw `Unknown ref` with a clear message ("Run a new snapshot and use a ref from that snapshot") instead of silently clicking wrong elements
- Replacement Page objects (Playwright returns a different `Page` for the same target) correctly share navigation lifecycle
- No impact on subframe navigations, existing snapshot→click workflow, or page close cleanup

## Real behavior proof

### Positive control (fix applied): 21 assertions passed, 0 failed
```
Fix status: APPLIED (post-fix)

[case 1] role-mode refs cleared on main-frame navigation
  ok: roleRefs populated
  ok: refLocator resolves e1 before navigation
  ok: FIXED: roleRefs cleared after navigation
  ok: FIXED: roleRefsMode cleared
  ok: FIXED: refLocator throws Unknown ref after navigation

[case 2] aria-mode refs cleared on main-frame navigation
  ok: aria roleRefs populated
  ok: FIXED: aria roleRefs cleared

[case 3] roleRefsFrameSelector cleared on main-frame navigation
  ok: frameSelector stored
  ok: FIXED: frameSelector cleared

[case 4] subframe navigation preserves roleRefs
  ok: roleRefs populated
  ok: roleRefs survive subframe navigation

[case 5] page close cleans up (existing behavior preserved)
  ok: new state has no roleRefs after close+reinit

[case 6] re-snapshot after navigation clear works
  ok: roleRefs cleared after navigation
  ok: new snapshot stores fresh refs after nav clear
  ok: fresh refs have correct role

[case 7] restoreRoleRefsForTarget blocked by target-scoped navGen after navigation
  ok: roleRefs populated
  ok: roleRefs cleared after navigation
  ok: FIXED: restore blocked — cached gen 0 ≠ target gen 1

[case 8] replacement Page restores refs when target gen matches
  ok: replacement Page restores refs when gen matches

[case 9] replacement Page rejects stale cache after target navigation
  ok: FIXED: replacement Page rejects stale gen-0 cache after target navigation

[case 10] replacement Page accepts fresh post-navigation cache
  ok: FIXED: replacement Page accepts fresh post-nav cache

ALL PROOF ASSERTIONS: 21 passed, 0 failed
```

### Negative control (old per-PageState navGen): 20 passed, 1 failed — confirmed v1 defect
```
[case 9] replacement Page rejects stale cache after target navigation
  FAIL: FIXED: replacement Page rejects stale gen-0 cache after target navigation

ALL PROOF ASSERTIONS: 20 passed, 1 failed
```

### Replacement Page proof: 4 dedicated scenarios
| Scenario | Result |
|----------|--------|
| Same gen → restore works | ✅ case 8 |
| Stale gen-0 cache → replacement rejects | ✅ case 9 |
| Post-nav fresh cache → replacement accepts | ✅ case 10 |
| Navigate → restore blocked (same page) | ✅ case 7 |

### Vitest results
```
 Test Files  5 passed (5)
      Tests  90 passed (90)
```
- 36 unit tests in `pw-session.test.ts` (all pass, including 4 replacement-Page scenarios)
- 54 related tests in snapshot/interactions/navigation-guard test files (all pass, no regressions)

### What was not tested
- Live browser roundtrip with real Chrome/CDP navigation

## Evidence

- Real production functions: `ensurePageState`, `storeRoleRefsForTarget`, `refLocator`, `restoreRoleRefsForTarget` (no mock)
- Negative control: `git stash` → run → confirmed old per-PageState navGen fails on replacement Page → `git stash pop`
- Lint: clean (`node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs`)
- Format: clean (`npx oxfmt --write`)
